summary: From 1 January 2027, NOTAMs for RAF Fairford will be issued in the Yankee series.
text:
WITH EFFECT FROM 01 JAN 27 NOTAM FOR RAF FAIRFORD (EGVA) WILL 
BE ISSUED AS A YANKEE SERIES. UK AIC Y104 DATED 15 OCT WILL REFER.
NOTAM THAT HAVE AN EFFECTIVE DATE OF 01 JAN 27 OR BEYOND WILL BE 
ISSUED AS A YANKEE SERIES. THE YANKEE SERIES AFTN DISTRIBUTION LIST 
WILL REFLECT THE ADDRESSES OF THE UNIFORM SERIES.
